title: MSME Bill Payment Days Prediction & Bill Analytics
description: Machine learning payment-days prediction system combined with bill and spend analytics to flag delayed MSME payments and give finance teams data-driven insights. Reduced delayed payments from 30% to 5% and helped unlock about GBP 20 thousand in cash flow.

title: Pot Digital Twin for Electrolysis Cells
description: Predictive digital twin for smelter pots, taking the work from problem framing to deployment and monitoring. In a 16-pot trial, Bath Temperature variation fell by 32% and the mean moved from 954°C to 951°C (target 950°C).

title: Hot Metal Product-Mix Optimisation
description: Greedy-heuristic model turning capacity constraints, margins and demand forecasts into the most profitable product mix. Identified ~$640K/year (~£500K) in opportunity cost.

title: PI System Implementation & Self-Service Data Catalogue
description: Consolidated data from 15+ standalone servers into a real-time OSI / AVEVA PI System, automated manual reports and built a metadata-rich data catalogue for self-service access.

title: Fail-Safe ELT Pipeline Redevelopment
description: Replaced a legacy ETL with an ELT pipeline featuring automated data quality checks, retries, alerts and monitoring. Cut service requests, ingestion time and storage by 30% each.
